flags.message: Snapshot 2026-11-05.json records on Sep 15 2026 'Brief amicus curiae of United States supporting vacatur filed. (Corrected)' (after an initial 'not accepted for filing' entry the same day), which predates the 2026-11-05 cutoff and postdates the Jun 29 2026 cert grant, but merits-amicus-united-states.txt is absent from record/documents/documents.json—likely because the 'supporting vacatur' or '(Corrected)' phrasing or the preceding rejection entry missed the document-staging matcher. Both parties' merits briefs and sg-invited-brief.txt were staged, and Respondent's merits brief cites and summarizes SG.Br. directly.
